name: Olympic Games 2000–2016
tagline: Real Olympic results from Kaggle — athletes, Games, events and medals.
description: Normalised from the Kaggle "120 years of Olympic history" dataset: Summer Games 2000–2016 for Athletics, Swimming, Badminton, Weightlifting and Table Tennis (all medal results plus a sample of non-medal entries). medal is NULL when no medal was won. Team events award a medal to every team member.
